text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...To the amusement park, with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wanting her to enjoy our outing even more,
I discovered that a nearby amusement park had just held its grand reopening.
choice_data_list: I thought it'd be a nice change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
If you say I'm needed, then I'll go.

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text: GRAAAAAAAARGH...!!

text_block_list.name: Zombie
text_block_list.text:
Hiiik...!
Au... va...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A haunted house... An excellent way to hone crisis management skills.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It seems this will help develop the ability to anticipate
the risk of injury during a race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her take from an athlete's perspective makes me uneasy.
Is she actually getting a break from all this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Next, I guided Duramente to
an airplane-themed thrill ride."

text_block_list.name: Airplane Pilot
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, we're caught in a hurricane!
Everyone, hold on tight!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: With this level of intensity, it should really train the semicircular canals well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Running with stable form on any track surface.
For that, balance is essential.
choice_data_list: (This totally isn't helping her relax at all!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Ferris wheel, the flying swings, the spinning teacups... We went on many more attractions after that, but Duramente's reaction remained unchanged.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I feel bad for dragging her along...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I guess there really are some things
you won't understand until you experience them yourself.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I had no connection to places like this as a child,
...but everything here looks like it could be turned into training.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Where will you take me next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every time she rode an attraction,
she pondered how she could apply it as an athlete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that she wasn't failing to unwind,
but rather... enjoying new discoveries
in her own way?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In that case, to make sure Duramente enjoys herself...
I want to give her an even fresher experience.
choice_data_list: How about the fantasy area next?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see... Alright, let's go. We might
just find a new training method.

text_block_list.name: Village Girl
text_block_list.text:
Please, Brave Hero! Deliver that sacred stone
safely to the castle!

text_block_list.name: Wolf Monster
text_block_list.text:
Grrr!
HAND IT OOOOVEEER!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I've figured it out—I see,
so that's how you avoid the enemies and advance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Make an instant decision and take evasive action.
That'll train your instantaneous reaction force.
choice_data_list: Then, how about charging straight into a horde of monsters?
Then, how about charging straight into a horde of monsters?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: This should build the strength to secure an open path!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I see...! In a race, you have to find the optimal
route while surrounded by other runners.
So this sharpens your judgment for that as well.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for the precise advice.
Now then, let us take the path with the most enemies."

text_block_list.name: Female Cast Member
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on clearing it~~~!
We also have an advanced course with extra monsters, so feel free to give it a try if you'd like~!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Advanced course.
choice_data_list: With you, I can conquer any course!
With you, I can conquer any course!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! I see...
If you say so—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: May I challenge it once more?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So it was the fastest clear time...
...A shame there isn't an ultra-expert course.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I thank you.
It has been a truly wonderful day and experience."
choice_data_list: Whenever you want to take a break, I'll gladly keep you company!
I'm glad you had a good time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Please do, by all means.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Because with you, I'm sure
we can make new discoveries.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...I had no idea amusement parks
were such fascinating places.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Next time I head out for a break...
maybe it wouldn't hurt to ask you to show me around.
